about_the_game:
A century of damnation. One hundred days for salvation. 

Age of Damnation is a top-view strategy set in a fantasy medieval world. By day, you explore the forest and build your settlement. By night, you defend against waves of monsters spawned by the damnation mist. Each level gives you 100 days to prepare for the final battle. Will you make it to the end, or will the curse claim you too?

Main Objectives and Gameplay

In Age of Damnation, you control settlers returning to lands covered in the damned fog. Your goal is to survive, build a sustainable settlement, and stop the source of damnation.

Each day is an active phase:

Explore the forest, find the lairs of the guardians of damnation. For each destroyed lair, you receive resources, technology, or new settlers. But remember, the more lairs you destroy, the more monsters attack at night.

Build houses, workshops, fences, and watchtowers.

Gather resources: wood, clay, food, and others. Provide settlers and soldiers with everything they need. If there is a shortage of houses, food, or safety, settlers become dissatisfied and stop working. Soldiers become weaker if there is not enough food.

Research new technologies to expand the settlement.

Each night is a wave of attacks:

The damned fog advances. Forest spirits, animals, and birds turn into aggressive creatures.

You must protect the settlement. Use walls, towers, and position defenders tactically.

Final:

Activate the Menhir. Summon the Guardian of Damnation… and kill him if you can. You might have to chase him for a while…

 Gameplay Features

  • Day and night cycle — explore, build, and develop the settlement during the day; defend against attacking creatures at night.

  • Real-time control — the game runs in real time. You can pause and speed up time.

  • 100-day timer — limited time to prepare for the final battle with the Guardian of Damnation.

  • Lairs of the guardians of damnation — find and destroy them to obtain resources, technology, or free settlers. Important: each destroyed lair strengthens the night waves.

  • Settlement growth — each freed settler becomes a new resident. This is the only way to increase population.

  • Menhir — an ancient stone on each level. Its activation is required to summon the Guardian of Damnation.

  • Direct control — you can control each settler directly, except for dissatisfied ones.

  • Final battle — after activating the Menhir, you can summon the Guardian of Damnation and fight him. Victory will free the lands.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit versions)
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i5-4670 (quad-core) / AMD® FX-Series™ FX-4350 (quad-core)
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce® GTX 1050 (2 GB) / AMD® Radeon™ RX-460 (4 GB) / Intel® Arc™ A380 (6 GB)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 5 GB available space

  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system

  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i5-7600 (quad-core) / AMD® Ryzen™ 3 2200G (quad-core)
  • Memory: 12 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce® GTX 1060 (6 GB) / AMD® Radeon™ RX 580 (8 GB) / Intel® Arc™ A580 (8 GB)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 5 GB available space

short_description: Age of Damnation — a fantasy medieval strategy with a top-down view. By day, you explore the forest and build your settlement. By night, you defend against waves of monsters born from damnation mist. Gather resources, develop your settlement, research technologies, build defenses, destroy monsters.
